newsitem.title: USA: Tele-Comms puts monthly hike at $1.72.
newsitem.headline: Tele-Comms puts monthly hike at $1.72.

text.p: Tele-Communications Inc's mid-year retail rate hike will average $1.72 a month, executives said on Thursday.
The average current monthly rate stands at $25.33.

The company earlier announced rate increases that would average below 6.8 percent on 11 million of its customers. The company cited higher programming costs as the major impetus behind the rate rises.

The average $1.72 per month increase breaks down as $0.89 for external, or increased programming costs, $0.43 for inflation that is allowed by the Federal Communications Commission and $0.40 that is arrived at by a formula that allows for past cost increases, Dick Treich, vice president for regulation told a teleconference call.
Customers who use set top boxes will see their equipoment rate rise by $0.47 a month, to $2.80. Most of TCI's customers do not need the set top box, Bob Thomson, TCI spokesman said.
